news.label: RTX Blackwell speedup
points: Inference latency cut by up to 15.34%
details: Attention processing on the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is reported to run up to 1.64 times faster.
In Reactor's world model serving setup, overall inference latency dropped by up to 15.34 percent.
The optimized code has been merged into FlashInfer's main branch. Results depend on the GPU, model, and runtime conditions.

lines.say: First up, NVIDIA. Four bit attention on R T X Blackwell is now up to one point six four times faster.
lines.show: First up, NVIDIA. Four-bit attention on RTX Blackwell is now up to 1.64 times faster.

lines.say: This could help bring video generation closer to real time.
lines.show: This could help bring video generation closer to real time.

news.label: Tripo to Painter, direct
details: You can now send generated models directly from Tripo Studio to Substance 3D Painter through your browser.
It supports Painter 10.0 or later on Windows and Mac, and installs as a Python plugin.
A prompt for asking an AI agent to handle the installation has also been published.

lines.say: Next, 3D creation. Models made in Tripo can now be sent straight to Substance three D Painter.
lines.show: Next, 3D creation. Models made in Tripo can now go straight to Substance 3D Painter.

lines.say: That should make the finishing steps a lot smoother.
lines.show: That should make the finishing steps a lot smoother.

link.title: Tripo DCC Bridge for Substance 3D Painter: Installation and Quick Start
link.description: Learn how to install Tripo DCC Bridge on Windows or macOS and send 3D models directly from Tripo Studio to Adobe Substance 3D Painter.

news.label: Ling-3.2-air released
details: Ling-3.2-air is a multimodal mixture of experts model with 124 billion total and 5.5 billion active parameters, and it accepts image and video input.
In official evaluations, its AutomationBench-AA score rose from 15.7 percent in the previous generation to 61 percent.
